title: ID Cards
description: Members are unable to download ID cards from their member website.

timeline.description: Automated monitoring detected unusual system behavior.
11 user-submitted tickets reporting the issue.
MI proposed by Internal Applications.
MI approved by manager.
User-facing banner added about the outage.
Pager sent for escalation.
War room created to handle incident response.

chat_log: Alice: Investigating now.
Bob: Seeing the same in Splunk.
Carol: On a call with vendor.

timeline.description: Rollback deployed and DB config reset per resolution notes.

post_incident_summary.summary: The issue titled 'ID Cards' caused disruptions until mitigated by internal teams.
post_incident_summary.root_cause: A configuration error during deployment introduced the issue.
post_incident_summary.timeline: Detected via logs, escalated by ticket volume, mitigated through rollback and patch.
post_incident_summary.impact: Impacted users were unable to use key services during the outage window.
post_incident_summary.detection: Triggered by monitoring and ticket surge.
post_incident_summary.response: Incident war room initiated and engineers collaborated on a fix.
post_incident_summary.recovery: Rollback and system reset resolved the issue.
post_incident_summary.prevention_plan: Code review improvements and enhanced monitoring alerts.
